The '''Pendarr system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Alchenaut sector/Legends|Alchenaut sector]] of the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pendarr III/Legends|Pendarr III]].
